ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (grayscale value >200) to low-intensity black pixels (grayscale value <50) across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black pigmentation forms a wide wedge-shaped manifold originating at the peduncle; extensive dark-pixel mottling and dendritic striations are distributed along the horizontal axis of the high-intensity white lobes, with higher density in the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 94 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total vertical fluke extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern characterized by pixel-amplitude variances ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant jaggedness and irregular peaks at both distal lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric parabolic sweep on leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoid curve transitioning from the concave median notch to the tapered, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixels in diameter) situated within the dark-intensity central pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense array of parallel and intersecting dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) predominantly oriented horizontally across the high-intensity white surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark patterning across both lobes; irregular pixel-level erosion and non-linear boundary disruptions at the trailing edge margins indicating historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dendritic 'bleeding' pattern at the interface where the dark central pigmentation zones transition into the white lobe regions.
